claims.claim: Dedicated runtime-identity helper resolves the actually imported AIOS package Git checkout root, normalized repository identity, and deterministic src/aios_renew tree fingerprint without network access or repository mutation.
Two checkouts recognized as the same repository identity with identical src/aios_renew tree fingerprints are admitted even when their HEAD commit SHAs differ.

Two checkouts recognized as the same repository identity with different src/aios_renew tree fingerprints fail closed before Executor dispatch with both checkout roots and tree fingerprints present in a bounded deterministic diagnostic.
Downstream subject repositories with different normalized repository identities are treated as NOT_APPLICABLE and existing execution admission behavior remains unchanged.
Applicable AIOS self-host cases whose loaded runtime source cannot establish required Git or tree identity fail closed with a specific identity-unavailable diagnostic before Executor dispatch.
Operator regression tests prove no native adapter or runner invocation occurs after runtime-drift failure, while matching and downstream cases preserve exactly-one normal dispatch behavior.
The guard performs only read-only local inspection, adds no auto-sync, retry, or fallback, changes no lifecycle artifact schema, and contains no machine-specific checkout paths.
